scope: Visual direction probes, not application implementation

prompts.name: Stage
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one exceptionally art-directed, high fidelity desktop web app visual direction study, landscape 1600x1000. The product is YAMA, an Indian incident-intelligence platform, and this is its private synthetic-demo intake screen with agent Saathi. User explicitly chose DARK, EXPRESSIVE, DITHERED after rejecting generic green Inter/Space Grotesk rounded-card AI layouts. Design quality should be that of a senior independent digital product studio. This is functional product UI, not a promotional landing page.
Visual direction STAGE: a private, intimate conversation stage. Background carbon #111214, subtle tonal surfaces #1b1d20, primary type silver-white #eceef1, secondary type #a8abb2. Neutral WHITE primary controls, with a restrained pale steel-blue #a7b9d8 for listening status only. No saturated bright accent colour. Typography uses IBM Plex Sans, clean neutral humanist forms, normal tracking; medium 32px task title, readable 16px transcript, deliberate 12px utility labels. Tiny letterspacing only for source references, no repetitive uppercase eyebrows, no oversized marketing hero. Bespoke compact lower-case Yama wordmark top left, sharp precise controls at 4px radius. No ghost cards, no glass, no bouncy interfaces, no gradients around buttons.
Topology: narrow quiet top chrome; top-left 'yama', top-right 'English / हिन्दी' and 'Leave'. Small central journey text 'Tell your story — Review — Understand — Next steps' with current stage gently emphasized. Beneath, an asymmetrical two-column composition: left 37% contains a large memorable hand-crafted dithered Saathi character, a small peaceful silver sparrow with detailed feather texture and dark wings, sitting attentively, head turned gently toward the conversation, no cartoon eyes and no policeman imagery. Monochrome Atkinson coarse stipple/bitmap shading, high quality editorial raster art integrated directly into the dark background, with extremely sparse pale steel-blue feather pixels. Character takes about 260px width, with abundant controlled negative space, not inside a card. Small caption 'Saathi' and 'Here with you'. RIGHT 63% is the actual conversation: prominent title 'Start with what you remember.' followed by only two lines 'You can pause, correct a detail, or switch to text.' One synthetic transcript in a flush, unboxed readable text block: 'I paid ₹4,800 for a used phone. The seller stopped replying.' followed by a modest underlined 'Correct this'. Then the Saathi response 'Do you remember when this happened?' and smaller supporting 'It’s okay if you don’t.' Bottom of this column, ONE compact voice console with native-looking mic icon, label 'Voice preview · mic off', pause button, and 'Type instead'. A crisp WHITE primary button labelled 'Review my details' with a slim arrow. Under the conversation at the bottom, a collapsed plain row labelled 'Your report so far' and '3 details · unconfirmed', separated by a single hairline, not a decorative card. Very small footer text 'Synthetic demo · no real report submitted'. Layout should feel spacious, editorial and intentional, with professional app controls, accurate generous alignment and optical spacing, not dashboard metrics or template panels.
Text should be correctly spelled and only the specified meaningful copy; no fake security certification, no safety promises, no numbers implying guilt or risk. Avoid acid green, orange-neon black SaaS look, pastel mint, pills everywhere, card grids, generic 3D orb, circular avatar frame, made-up scores, giant forms, laptop/device surround, browser frame, marketing sections. Render the entire viewport as an app design study, straight-on, crisp and believable.

prompts.name: Desk
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one exceptionally art-directed, high fidelity desktop web app visual direction study, landscape 1600x1000. Product YAMA, Indian incident-intelligence platform. Same private synthetic-demo Saathi intake content as below. User chose DARK, EXPRESSIVE, DITHERED and rejected generic green Space Grotesk/Inter rounded-card AI UI. This alternate direction is DESK: a humane report workspace, not a marketing page. Design should look like a mature independent studio product interface with precise alignment, custom component proportions and clean restrained chrome.
Carbon background #111214; slightly lighter graphite navigation and report panel #1b1d20; legible silver-white #eceef1, muted secondary #a8abb2, restrained pale steel blue #a7b9d8 only for the current workflow/links. Primary action WHITE with dark text. No neon accent. Fonts IBM Plex Sans with regular, medium and semibold hierarchy, 28px heading, 16px conversation text, 13px controls. IBM Plex Mono for source IDs only. A precise humanist type system, normal letterspacing. Sharp small 4px control corners, ample text leading, no repetitive tiny uppercase eyebrows, no round pill navigation, no gradient border/soft shadow panels.
Topology distinct from voice stage: narrow 180px full-height left navigation separated by a single hairline, wordmark 'yama', a small active 'Your report', below 'Explore patterns', bottom 'Free assistance' and 'Synthetic demo'. MAIN middle 60% is the conversation notebook: top breadcrumb 'Your report / Tell your story', right 'English / हिन्दी'. Strong working title 'What happened?' with one supporting sentence 'Start anywhere. We’ll review the details together.' Under it, a beautiful compact horizontally aligned Saathi identity row: a dithered silver sparrow profile about 56px square, integrated with charcoal, no enclosing circle, next to 'Saathi' and 'Intake'. Spacious, unboxed transcript with a subtle source label 'You · original transcript', main text 'I paid ₹4,800 for a used phone. The seller stopped replying.' and discreet underlined 'Correct detail'. Next reply 'Do you remember when this happened?' The composer sits beneath, a single wide flush graphite text field with native mic and paperclip icons, placeholder 'Write in English or Hindi…', with a square send control. Under composer show 'Talk instead' and a WHITE button 'Review details'. No endless chat bubbles; conversation looks like a carefully typeset working document.
RIGHT 26% is a report inspector, slightly lighter background and a single vertical dividing rule. Header 'Report outline' and a small neutral 'Unconfirmed' label, no checkmark implying verified. It holds a small expressive dithered bird artwork about 130px wide above the structured details. The bird is a peaceful silver sparrow with detailed black-and-white Atkinson bitmap feathering, head tilted attentively. Three simple stacked fact rows separated by hairlines, labels 'Amount', 'Item', 'Date', values '₹4,800', 'Used phone', 'Not supplied', and source references 'Transcript 1' in compact mono. A plain note 'You can change or remove details before confirming.' Inspector looks refined and useful; no stacked rounded cards, no dashboards, no invented confidence score. Tiny bottom action 'View original'. Main content stays comfortable, not cramped. Align conversation baseline and inspector baseline expertly.
Optional chrome at the top of the main content: restrained text steps 'Tell — Review — Understand — Act', no giant numbered stepper. This is a real product workflow and every label must earn its place.
Render a complete crisp straight-on desktop app screenshot-style concept, no device mockup/browser border. No fake validation successes, no private victim info from other reports, no numbers estimating guilt. Avoid acid green, vermilion neon, mint surfaces, glass, gradients, huge rounded panels, excessive badges, stock 3D orb, stereotypical AI dashboard composition. All text correctly spelled. Make it materially different from the centered conversation stage, using the inspectable report notebook architecture described.
